claim: Patchline ships a DOI-pinned snapshot with a bit-identical rebuild attestation and frozen dependency closure. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the DOI snapshot attestation claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make doi-snapshot-attestation-2-gate`.
